title: Maneuver vector display
summary: Removable node and predicted trajectory overlays over detached read-only snapshots.

blocks.text: This presentation module contributes vector overlay primitives for displaying planned maneuver nodes, burn delta-v vectors, burn durations, and predicted post-burn trajectory paths. It draws node diamond markers, directional arrows, and decimated Hermite trajectory path segments in world coordinates without executing flight commands or mutating simulation state.

items: Provides view.maneuver-display@1.0.0 through presentation layer registration.
Requires no external services in its module manifest.
Initialization registers the maneuver presentation layer and contributes this guide.
During rendering, drawManeuver inspects the presentation view's active maneuver snapshot.
Generates world-space line primitives for node markers, delta-v arrows, and predicted path intervals.
Renders text primitives for countdowns, node labels, and delta-v magnitude readouts.

blocks.text: To customize maneuver node visual markers or projected trajectory styling, contribute an alternative presentation provider implementing view.maneuver-display@1.0.0. Removing this module omits maneuver graphics from the rendered view while preserving planned burn execution.

Module version 0.1.0 uses API space-sim-game-api/2 and manifest format space-sim-module/2. Both are pre-freeze: primitive generation contracts and trajectory Hermite decimation bounds may evolve prior to final API freeze.
examples/modules/maneuver-display demonstrates generating maneuver overlays from simulated view state and inspecting output primitives. Build and validate it from the repository root:

npm run module:build -- examples/modules/maneuver-display/module.json /tmp/example-maneuver-display.spacemod
npm run module:validate -- /tmp/example-maneuver-display.spacemod
